gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: Put an enchanted book that holds a single enchantment in the first slot, and the materials for the next level beside it
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 在左边第一格放一本只带一条附魔的附魔书，旁边两格放下一级要的材料

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: Only enchanted books with exactly one enchantment work: with several, there is no telling which one to raise
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 只收刚好带一条附魔的附魔书：有好几条的话，机器没法决定升哪一条

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: This enchantment has only one level, is a curse, or is refused by enchantment_caps in the config
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 这种附魔只有一级、是诅咒，或者被配置里的 enchantment_caps 排除了

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: The Ascender only takes books that already have level 25: raise them that far in an Enchantment Amplifier first
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 升华台只收已经有 25 级的书：先拿到增幅台里推到 25 级

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: Take the finished book out of the output slot
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 把做好的书从输出格里拿走

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: The Ascender works on its owner's matrix, so the player who placed it has to be online. A machine nobody placed does not run on a server
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 升华台要动主人的矩阵，放下它的玩家得在线；没有主人的机器在服务器上不工作

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: The owner must have opened a Soul Pentacle of a high enough tier to be able to cure matrix damage (see required_pentacle_tier in the config)
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 主人得打开过足够高档的灵魂五芒星，高到能治矩阵损伤（档位见配置 required_pentacle_tier）

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: The owner's matrix damage is too close to the cap for this step. Cure it at a Soul Pentacle first
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 主人的矩阵损伤离上限太近，放不下这一步：先去灵魂五芒星治一治

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.en: One tick of this step costs more MRU or ESPE than the machine can store. Raise max_mru / max_espe or lower the multipliers in the config
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.stat.zh: 这一步每刻要的 MRU 或 ESPE 比机器存得下的还多：调大配置里的 max_mru / max_espe，或调低倍率

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.targ.en: Stop at this level: the book goes to the output slot once it gets there
gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.targ.zh: 升到几级就停：书到了这一级才送进输出格

gui.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade.step.zh: 材料一：%s 个%s（同类任选一种）
材料二：%s 个%s（同类任选一种）
记到主人身上的矩阵损伤：%s

message.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade..en: Level %s reached; your matrix took %s damage
message.essentialcraft5.enchant_upgrade..zh: 升到 %s 级，你的矩阵承受了 %s 点损伤
